fusions.name: Fine-Spun Shaft
fusions.desc: Fires a thread-trailing arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangling Fan
fusions.desc: Looses a fan of cord-trailing arrows 5 tiles ahead that deals 11 damage to everything in it, stuns each for 1 second and leaves them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plaited Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds, and gives you 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Gathered Strands
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
